status_code_data.description: The HTTP 203 Non-Authoritative Information successful response status code indicates that the request was successful, but a transforming proxy has modified the headers or enclosed content from the origin server's 200 OK response.

meme_data.description: Let's See Who This Really Is, also known as Scooby Doo Reveal, is an exploitable image macro series featuring a scene from the Scooby Doo animated television series in which a man dressed as a ghost is unmasked.
